An enigmatic person shrouded in pure white.
Legends say they appear when the world is
plunged into chaos. Appears in Fire Emblem:
Fortune's Weave.

Mythic Effect: Anima
Boost: HP+5, Def+5

Grants allies this Mythic Effect during Anima
season, if the Anima blessing has been conferred
and if this unit enters battle in Aether Raids with
them: Anima-blessed allies decrease the
Aetheric Lift lost for defense failures during
Anima season. (This decrease is limited to the
number of Mythic Heroes (Max: 2) × the number
of Heroes with the blessing conferred × 5.)

During Anima season, this Mythic Hero will
decrease Aetheric Lift loss for defense
failures depending on number of merges. (This
decrease is limited to the number of times the
units have been merged × 1 (Max: 20).)

Mythic Effect 2: Anima
Boost: Defensive Team Bonus

Mythic Effect 3: Anima
Boost: Defensive Team Call
(Details can be found in Edit Defensive Team.)

Legendary Effect: Water
Ally Boost: HP+3, Atk+2

Grants allies this Legendary Effect during Water
season, if the Water blessing has been conferred
and if this unit enters battle with them.

Standard Effect 1: Duel
If unit is 5★ and level 40 and unit's stats total
less than 220, treats unit's stats as 220 in
modes like Arena. (Higher-scoring opponents
will appear. Stat total calculation excludes any
values added by merges and skills.)
Standard Effect 2: Pair Up
An ability that can only be used under certain
circumstances. Pair Up can be accessed from
the Interact with Allies menu, and allows this
unit to join battle in a group with another ally.
Enables Re-Act in Arena and Aether\nRaids. Leaps in to aid allies, then\nunleashes an area-of-effect Special!
Use Time's Gate to advance and grant\nextra actions to your allies! Can\nimmediately end a foe's action!

$aEnables the Re-Act feature in Arena or Aether
Raids (the same effect as the Feh Pass's
Re-Act feature; twice per map; does not
stack; does not trigger when deployed as
reinforcement).

Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
Unit can move through foes' spaces.

Unit can move to a space within 2 spaces of
any ally that has entered combat during the
current turn.

If a Rally or movement Assist skill is used by
unit and if target ally has already entered
combat on the current turn and completed their
action, grants another action to that ally. If
Canto has already been triggered by target ally,
re-enables Canto (once per turn; if another
effect that grants action to target ally has been
activated at the same time, this effect is also
considered to have been triggered).

After Canto, if unit used an Assist skill on
the current turn, grants another action to unit
and re-enables Canto (once per turn; does not
trigger when affected by effects of traps in
Aether Raids during Canto).

At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants
Atk/Spd+6,【Union】, and "neutralizes foe's
bonuses during combat" to unit and allies within
2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.

Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+15 to unit, unit deals
+25 damage (including area-of-effect Specials),
reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15
(excluding area-of-effect Specials), and
reduces damage from foe's Specials by an
additional 15 during combat (excluding
area-of-effect Specials).

【Union】
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X to unit during
combat (X = number of allies on the map
with Union active, including unit, × 2; max 8).

If a Rally or movement Assist skill is used by
unit or targets unit, grants Union to target ally
or targeting ally for 1 turn.

If unit initiates combat, grants Union to allies
within 3 spaces of unit after combat for 1 turn.

If ally within 3 spaces of unit initiates combat,
grants Union to that ally after their combat for
1 turn.

Foe's attacks deal +10 damage.

through unit's next action.

Restricts target's movement to 1 space through
its next action.
